body.statement:
Suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\delta_n(C)=\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) on every rational compact polytope \(C\).  Choose rational \(\xi_n\downarrow0\) and \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\).  Then \(c_n\) and \(\widehat c_n\) lie eventually in a fixed compact \(C_c\subset\mathcal K_0\), each rational offset experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) is a fully encoded experiment, and the unconditional comparison in \(\text{lem:moving-offset-carter-geometry}\) applies to any supplied Gaussian rule.  In particular, with \(H_C=H(C,C_c)\), \(A_0\) as displayed there, \(\chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\), and any upper bound \(\overline\chi_n(C)\ge\chi_n(C)\), its comparison charge is
\[
\Delta_n(C)=C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}
+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
+\{H_C+2A_0\}\overline\chi_n(C).
\]
Taking \(\overline\chi_n(C)=\chi_n(C)\) proves qualitative compact convergence and makes no effectiveness claim.  A finite replayable Gaussian rule and its gluing ledger are available only conditional on the affirmative conclusion specified in \(\text{oeq:effective-compatible-density}\), or on a separately proved sufficient compatibility package.  Replayable comparison-error accounting additionally requires effective rational upper enclosures for \(d_n(C)\) and \(\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\) to be supplied as inputs; neither those enclosures nor the Gaussian-rule construction follows from the qualitative comparison.  No global honesty or risk conclusion is asserted outside \(C\).
body.justification: The theorem now gives a determinate compact moving-offset rule using computable rational approximations to the observed offset.
body.gap: It does not extend compact control to all unbounded finite-sample truth regions.
body.consumer: Drifting capacity and endpoint-program faces receive an explicit boundary and offset charge.
body.proof_tex:
\textbf{Technique: compatible affine-offset lifting followed by the unconditional Carter--geometry lemma; effectivity is separated from qualitative convergence.}

Let \(A_\Psi\) have rows \(\alpha_j'\), \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), and write
\(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Since every active cut has \(\psi_j(p_0)=0\),
\[
c_n=A_\Psi\sqrt n\{p_n(0)-p_0\}.
\tag{21}
\]
The local-family affine-hull assumption places the vector inside braces in \(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  By the definition of \(\mathcal K_0\),
\[
c_n\in\mathcal K_0\qquad\text{for every }n.
\tag{22}
\]
The effective moving-offset encoding assumption supplies the declared rational \(\widehat c_n\) for each chosen rational \(\xi_n>0\).  Because \(c_n\to c\), \(\xi_n\to0\), and
\(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), there is a closed bounded set \(C_c\subset\mathcal K_0\) containing both sequences after finitely many indices.  In finite dimension this set is compact.  This discharges, rather than silently assumes, the compact-offset premise of \(\text{lem:moving-offset-carter-geometry}\), and fixes
\[
H_C=H(C,C_c)<\infty.
\tag{23}
\]

The local expansion and \(\text{lem:compact-moving-remainder-covariance}\) give
\[
d_n(C)\to0,
\qquad \delta_n(C)\to0,
\qquad \operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\to0.
\tag{24}
\]
Therefore \(\chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\to0\).  Apply \(\text{lem:moving-offset-carter-geometry}\) first with an arbitrary supplied bound \(\overline\chi_n(C)\ge\chi_n(C)\).  It yields the displayed \(\Delta_n(C)\).  In particular the mathematical choice
\(\overline\chi_n(C)=\chi_n(C)\) is valid without being computable, and (23)--(24) imply \(\Delta_n(C)\to0\).  This proves the unconditional qualitative statistical comparison for every supplied Gaussian rule.

We next verify that the rule's offset experiment is legitimate.  Since \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\), rational linear algebra gives a rational \(z_n\in L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) satisfying
\(A_\Psi z_n=\widehat c_n\).  For each fixed \(u\), relative interiority and tangent-image compatibility give, for all sufficiently small positive \(t\),
\[
p_0+t(z_n+Bu)\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}.
\tag{25}
\]
The compatible completed branch at (25) has active signs
\[
\operatorname{sgn}\{\alpha_j'(z_n+Bu)\}
=\operatorname{sgn}(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u),
\tag{26}
\]
and a zero sign belongs to every incident completion.  Hence the offset semantic cells cover \(\mathbb R^d\).

For nonemptiness of the separated domain, take a strict chamber direction of the homogeneous completed fan.  Along a sufficiently large multiple of that direction the fixed offset in (26) is dominated by the strict homogeneous slacks.  For each rival polyhedral component there is a nonzero rational row \(a'\) whose gap is \(t\gamma+O(1)\), \(\gamma>0\).  Every point \(g\) in that rival satisfies
\[
t\gamma+O(1)\le a'(ty-g)
\le\|a\|_{\Sigma_0}\|ty-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}.
\tag{27}
\]
The divisor \(\|a\|_{\Sigma_0}\) is positive because \(a\ne0\) and \(\Sigma_0\succ0\).  Taking the infimum over \(g\) and then the minimum over finitely many rivals shows that the separation eventually exceeds \(r_0\).  If the active list is empty, the unique global semantic label gives the conclusion directly.  Thus the offset object has a complete cover, rational encoding, positive definite covariance, and nonempty separated domain; it belongs to \(\mathfrak E\).

The preceding argument constructs no finite Gaussian rule.  If the affirmative conclusion specified in \(\text{oeq:effective-compatible-density}\), or a separately proved sufficient compatibility package, is supplied, then the conditional \(\text{thm:certglue-termination}\) produces such a finite replayable rule and its outward Gaussian ledger.  Composing it with Carter's forward kernel adds \(\Delta_n(C)\) to the certified chart, tail, integration, and rounding charges.  The standing effective moving-remainder and offset-encoding assumptions provide effective bounds only for \(\delta_n(C)\) and \(\xi_n\).  To turn the complete comparison charge into a replayable numerical receipt one must additionally supply effective rational upper enclosures for \(d_n(C)\) and \(\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\).  This is an input condition for replayability, not a scientific assumption and not a consequence of effective compatible density.  Every supremum above is restricted to \(C\), so no unbounded-region conclusion follows.
